decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution is a core, government-embedded offering used by the UK Home Office and connected to over 30 APIS schemes, so it generates sticky recurring business.

The travel health requirements API has lost some relevance since the pandemic but still complements the firm's travel data and document verification portfolio at low maintenance cost, and it stayed on its own page in 2024.
The travel and document verification platform fits growing regulatory demand such as ETIAS and ETA and the firm's aviation security focus, and it was presented consistently in both years.
